title: ServerKit template registry index
description: Catalog of one-click app templates. ServerKit fetches this document from <repo_url>/index.json and resolves each template on demand from <repo_url>/templates/<id>.yaml.

name.description: Human-readable repository name, shown beside the templates it contributes.

updated.description: Date of the last index change (YYYY-MM-DD).

count.description: Number of entries in `templates`. Generated; validated for agreement.

id.description: Stable slug. MUST equal the filename stem of templates/<id>.yaml — the panel builds the download URL from it.

name.description: Display name shown on the catalog card.

version.description: Version of the UPSTREAM APPLICATION (e.g. "1.23" for Uptime Kuma), not of this template. See `revision`.

revision.description: Revision of the TEMPLATE ITSELF, bumped for a compose/port/healthcheck fix that ships no new upstream version. RESERVED: current panels compare `version` for update detection and ignore this field, so bumping it alone will not yet prompt an update.

description.description: One-line summary for the catalog card.

icon.description: https URL or data: URI for the card icon.

categories.description: Free-form lowercase tags used for catalog filtering. Deliberately not an enum — the catalog spans ~100 categories and new apps coin new ones.

featured.description: Float this template to the top of the catalog, and to the top of whatever category filter is active. Reserved for first-party templates; ordering is otherwise alphabetical. Mirrors `featured` in the serverkit-extensions index.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of templates/<id>.yaml. Not yet verified panel-side; published so verification can be enabled without a reindex, and so a diff names exactly which templates changed.
